positions.name: IdlessSubmissionHandling
positions.frame: what must the pipeline do when a memory is submitted without an explicit id field?
positions.why: src-1 establishes the precondition — a submission arrives lacking an explicit id — and src-2 states the mandatory response the pipeline must perform in that circumstance (produce a slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic fallback, then commit). Read together, one directional line runs from the missing-id fact to the required remedy; the conviction gradient (flat claim in src-1, decision-level 'must' in src-2) tracks that same precondition-to-requirement arc rather than breaking it. No existing positions were supplied to consult, and no strata or narrative structure was supplied to place this under.
